What should I do if the tracking never updates?
If you’ve received your shipping confirmation email, tracking should become active within 24 hours of that email.
If it’s been longer than that (or you never received a shipping confirmation), the quickest next step is to check your order status directly. If you share the email used at checkout and your order number, we can look up the latest status and tracking details.

How do I find my tracking link?
You’ll find your tracking link in the shipping confirmation email we send once your order ships—open that email and look for the tracking number/link.
If you can’t find that email, check your spam/junk folder (and any “Promotions”/filtered inbox tabs).
If you want, you can also tell me the email used at checkout and your order number, and we can pull up the latest status/tracking for you.
